outcome: Impaired glucose tolerance or gestational diabetes
cohort: 1,591 pregnant patients with a history of bariatric surgery and 7,955 pregnant patients without a history of bariatric surgery
finding: Pregnancy after bariatric surgery was associated with a decreased risk of preeclampsia, gestational diabetes or impaired fasting glucose, and LGA neonates, and an increased risk of SGA neonates compared with pregnant patients in a matched control group.
